display_long_description:
This isn’t your typical  supermarket simulator —  it’s full-blown retail chaos in VR.

Welcome to **Shop & Stuff**, a store where customers argue, machines break, shoplifters run, floors get messy, and now everyone talks back.

Stock the shelves  and react to unexpected situations,  or watch your shift collapse in real time.

# Reactive Customers
[media]

All characters are now fully voiced. They comment on what you do. They react to spills. They complain. They provoke.

Customers no longer just shop, they engage with you and escalate situations into hilarious, unpredictable moments.

# Run the Chaotic Store
[media]
Stock shelves. Scan items. Handle rush hour. Miss a detail? The chaos builds.

From impatient buyers to sneaky shoplifters, every shift becomes a reactive sandbox of problems that demand fast decisions.

# Everything is Interactive 
[media]
Customers now bring fully usable objects into the store: frying pans, Nerf guns, squeaking toys, cash…and more.

Every item is interactive. Every object can trigger new reactions.
What starts as a normal transaction can turn into total absurdity.

# Mess is Part of the Game 
[media]
Spilled drinks. Dropped food. Mystery gunk. Ignore the mess and customers react. Clean too slowly and chaos spreads.

Everything is physics-driven. Everything affects the mood of your store.

Grow from a tiny roadside shop into a fully operational barely controlled retail machine.

Fully voiced chaos. Reactive customers. Physics-driven disasters.

Can you keep your store running when everyone fights back?
